Theme

connect verb

also join together, combine

classical

conjungō, conjungere

verb, third conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

connect, join together

Other words

  • cōnectō (connectō), cōnectere, cōnexuī, cōnexum — connect, link

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 295; Lewis & Short s.v. cōnectō (less correctly connectō); Traupman 260, 261 · Conjugation on Wiktionary

  • compōnō, compōnere, composuī, compositum — combine, put together

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 294 · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Examples

  • Fistulās inter sē conjungunt.

    They are connecting the tubes together.composed

  • Praepositiōnēs cum verbīs compōnī possunt.

    Prepositions can be combined with verbs.Traupman 294

See also joint, coupler, assemble.

SourcesLewis & Short: conjungo

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
